description: Rich text facets used to add flare to entries.

colour.description: Facet feature for coloured text. Colours must be hexadecimal values, implementors should ensure the colours are accessible for the current theme.

code.description: Facet feature for monospaced text, usually for displaying inline snippets of code.

highlight.description: Facet feature for a highlighted region of text. Colours must be hexadecimal values, implementors should ensure the colours are accessible for the current theme.
